cur.title: Surviving the Night
cur.summary: The first nights are the steepest. Get through tonight, nothing else.
cur.cardSummary: Put the device you use for porn out of reach before you sleep.
cur.done: Done when you can’t reach your usual device from bed without standing up.

cur.title: A New Start
cur.summary: Day zero isn’t a loss. It’s the start of the count that matters.
cur.cardSummary: Clean the space you use most and remove easy porn cues.
cur.done: Done when the timer rings and your most-used space holds fewer cues.

cur.title: Get Outside
cur.summary: Daylight, air, one walk. The room you’re in is half the battle.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 20 minutes away from your usual relapse setting.
cur.done: Done after 20 minutes away from the usual setting — not scrolling elsewhere.

cur.title: Fix Your Sleep
cur.summary: Tired brains lose to urges. Protect the hours that rebuild you.
cur.cardSummary: Set tomorrow’s alarm and decide when and where your phone goes away tonight.
cur.done: Done when the alarm is set and the phone has a cutoff time and a fixed place.

cur.title: What Replaces Porn?
cur.summary: The habit filled a slot. Decide what takes the space.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 20 minutes learning something new.
cur.done: Done when you can explain or use one thing you couldn’t this morning.

cur.title: Isolation
cur.summary: Urges grow in closed rooms. Open one door today.
cur.cardSummary: Spend at least 10 minutes talking with or being around another person.
cur.done: Done after 10 minutes talking or doing something together.

cur.title: One Week In
cur.summary: Seven days held. Look at what a week actually bought you.
cur.cardSummary: Reward yourself for finishing your first week.
cur.done: Done when you’ve taken the reward. Nothing else is assigned today.

cur.title: More Than a Streak
cur.summary: The count is a tool, not the point. You’re building a person.
cur.cardSummary: Notice three ways your behaviour has changed and repeat one today.
cur.done: Done when three changes are written and you’ve repeated one today.

cur.title: After a Relapse
cur.summary: A relapse is data. Read it, log it, move.
cur.cardSummary: Review what happened after your last relapse and plan how to stop the next part sooner.
cur.done: Done when the note holds what happened, the stop point, and next time’s plan.

cur.title: The All-or-Nothing Trap
cur.summary: One slip doesn’t erase thirty days. Refuse the reset story.
cur.cardSummary: Practise a four-step plan for stopping one relapse from turning into another.
cur.done: Done when the four steps are written and the route is physically tested.

cur.title: Progress Isn’t Linear
cur.summary: The curve wobbles on its way up. Zoom out.
cur.cardSummary: Compare this week with before Vici and change the area that still causes the most trouble.
cur.done: Done when three comparisons are written and this week’s change has begun.

cur.title: Identity
cur.summary: Stop fighting as a user who quits. Act as someone who doesn’t need it.
cur.cardSummary: Choose one behaviour you want to repeat for the next week and prepare for it today.
cur.done: Done when the rule is written, prepared for, and rep one is done or booked.

cur.title: Values, Not Shame
cur.summary: Shame burns fuel. Values steer. Swap the engine.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 20 minutes on something you care about that porn has been taking time from.
cur.done: Done when it’s written down and has had its 20 minutes.

cur.title: Keep Going
cur.summary: Two weeks of momentum. Don’t trade it for a quiet Tuesday.
cur.cardSummary: Make a simple plan for how you will continue after missed days, relapse, or low motivation.
cur.done: Done when you know your move for all three — no motivation required.

cur.title: The Life of an Urge
cur.summary: Every urge has a birth, a peak, and a death. Learn its shape.
cur.cardSummary: Keep your phone away for 10 minutes and rate how much you want to check it.
cur.done: Done when the phone stayed away 10 minutes and all three ratings exist.

cur.title: What’s the Urge Really For?
cur.summary: The urge points at a need. Find what it’s actually asking for.
cur.cardSummary: Look at the circumstances around your most recent strong urge.
cur.done: Done when the facts are written — even if the why stays unknown.

cur.title: Move First
cur.summary: Don’t negotiate standing still. Move your body first.
cur.cardSummary: Practise leaving the place where you are most likely to relapse.
cur.done: Done when the whole exit has been physically performed once.

cur.title: Redirection
cur.summary: Attention is a channel. You hold the remote.
cur.cardSummary: Prepare four easy things you can do instead of staying on a screen.
cur.done: Done when all four can be started in under a minute.

cur.title: HALT
cur.summary: Hungry, angry, lonely, tired — check the gauges before you judge the pull.
cur.cardSummary: Check whether you are hungry, angry, lonely, or tired and deal with any that apply.
cur.done: Done when all four are answered and every yes got its response.

cur.title: Urge Surfing
cur.summary: Don’t fight the wave. Ride it until it breaks.
cur.cardSummary: Practise urge surfing for five minutes using the urge to check your phone.
cur.done: Done after five clean minutes and one written body sensation.

cur.title: Masturbation
cur.summary: Decide the rule on purpose, not in the moment.
cur.cardSummary: Set a two-week masturbation rule based on whether it tends to lead you back to porn.
cur.done: Done when the rule is written and devices sit where the rule says.

cur.title: The Reward System
cur.summary: Dopamine isn’t pleasure. It’s the promise of it.
cur.cardSummary: Remove one set of cues that regularly puts sexual content in front of you.
cur.done: Done when the timer ends and one recurring cue is harder to reach.

cur.title: The Control Center
cur.summary: The prefrontal cortex tires like a muscle. Guard its hours.
cur.cardSummary: Put Vici Urge Surfing one tap away and give your phone a fixed place for tonight.
cur.done: Done when Urge Surfing opens in one tap and tonight’s spot is fixed.

cur.title: Hungry and Tired
cur.summary: Low fuel and low sleep read as craving. Feed the real need.
cur.cardSummary: Eat, drink, and prepare for sleep before the risky part of the day.
cur.done: Done when food is handled, water is poured, and sleep has its plan.

cur.title: Angry and Lonely
cur.summary: Anger and loneliness borrow the same circuits. Name them early.
cur.cardSummary: Compare how anger and loneliness affect you and practise one response.
cur.done: Done when both are written and one response has been practised.

cur.title: The Pull of Novelty
cur.summary: Novelty is the hook. Infinite variety is the trap.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 15 minutes on one thing without switching to something newer.
cur.done: Done when the 15 minutes end and the tally count is written.

cur.title: Change Your State
cur.summary: State beats willpower. Change temperature, posture, place.
cur.cardSummary: Compare your physical arousal before and after movement and slower breathing.
cur.done: Done when both ratings and one observation are written.

cur.title: Autopilot
cur.summary: Half your day runs on scripts. Rewrite the opening scene.
cur.cardSummary: Change the first action that usually starts your porn routine.
cur.done: Done when that first step is harder to repeat the usual way.

cur.title: The Scale
cur.summary: Every choice sits on a scale. See both pans clearly.
cur.cardSummary: Plan one high-risk two-hour block before it arrives.
cur.done: Done when the block has a place, an activity, and a phone rule.

cur.title: The “Benefits” of Porn
cur.summary: It gives something real. Name it honestly or it keeps the leverage.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 20 minutes meeting the need that usually makes porn appealing in another way.
cur.done: Done after 20 minutes on the alternative, porn unopened.

cur.title: The Hidden Reward
cur.summary: Relief now is the hidden payment. Check the receipt.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 15 minutes starting something you have been avoiding.
cur.done: Done when the timer ends and something visible exists.

cur.title: The Short-Term Cost
cur.summary: Write down what a late relapse costs tomorrow morning and prepare that morning now.
cur.cardSummary: Write down what a late relapse costs tomorrow morning and prepare that morning now.
cur.done: The task is done when the three costs are written and tomorrow has an alarm, a first activity, and a phone location.

cur.title: The Long-Term Cost
cur.summary: Years of nights compound. Price the decade, not the evening.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 30 minutes on something you want to be better a year from now.
cur.done: Done after 30 minutes on the thing you chose.

cur.title: Tipping the Scale
cur.summary: Stack today’s pan: one call, one walk, one early night.
cur.cardSummary: Make porn harder to reach by removing one saved route and moving one device.
cur.done: Done when both routes cost more effort than they did this morning.

cur.title: Repairing the Scale
cur.summary: Rig the scale so staying clean is the easy read.
cur.cardSummary: Schedule four sessions of something you want more of in your week.
cur.done: Done when four sessions are booked and the first is moving.

cur.title: What is Willpower?
cur.summary: Willpower drains. Systems don’t. Build for the tired version of you.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 15 minutes staying with one task even when you want to switch away.
cur.done: Done when you’ve stayed with the one task the full 15 minutes.

cur.title: Train Your Response
cur.summary: Reps, not speeches. Each refusal makes the next one cheaper.
cur.cardSummary: Practise your urge-exit sequence three times.
cur.done: Done when the same exit has been run three times.

cur.title: What Discipline Isn’t
cur.summary: Discipline isn’t punishment or gritted teeth.
cur.cardSummary: Finish one necessary task without turning it into a punishment or test.
cur.done: Done when the task is finished. Nothing extra is required.

cur.title: What Discipline Is
cur.summary: It’s choosing once, early, and letting the choice stand.
cur.cardSummary: Practise starting, staying with, returning to, and stopping a task on time.
cur.done: Done when the full 15-minute run is complete.

cur.title: Thoughts and Feelings
cur.summary: Thoughts and feelings are weather. You’re the ground.
cur.cardSummary: Write down a thought that usually comes before porn and practise what you want to do instead.
cur.done: Done when thought and action are written and rehearsed once.

cur.title: Choose Your Action
cur.summary: You can’t pick the impulse. You pick the action.
cur.cardSummary: Write three simple rules for situations that have caught you before and make one easier to follow.
cur.done: Done when three rules exist and one got physically easier today.

cur.title: Damage Control
cur.summary: Bad night? Contain it. One fire, not a season.
cur.cardSummary: Decide the three things you will still do on a bad day.
cur.done: Done when the three rules are saved somewhere reachable.

cur.title: Relapse Isn’t the End
cur.summary: A relapse ends a streak. It doesn’t end the campaign.
cur.cardSummary: Write down what the next 24 hours should look like after a relapse.
cur.done: Done when all five parts are written and morning is prepared.

cur.title: Learn From the Relapse
cur.summary: Autopsy, not funeral. What time, what door, what state?
cur.cardSummary: Reconstruct your last relapse and change the earliest step you can control.
cur.done: Done when the order is written and the earliest change is made.

cur.title: Don’t Punish Yourself
cur.summary: Punishment teaches hiding. Debrief teaches prevention.
cur.cardSummary: Write and save a plan for the first hour after a relapse.
cur.done: Done when the note is written and pinned.

cur.title: Rough Days
cur.summary: Some days the plan is smaller: eat, walk, sleep clean.
cur.cardSummary: Reduce a rough day to three things that still need to happen.
cur.done: Done when the list is three items and the first has started.

cur.title: When Life Gets Hard
cur.summary: Hard seasons raise the stakes. Shrink the promise, keep it daily.
cur.cardSummary: Decide what you will keep doing through several bad days and tell someone you may contact them.
cur.done: Done when the note exists and the message is sent.

cur.title: Face What You’re Avoiding
cur.summary: The urge often guards a door. Open what you’re avoiding.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 15 minutes on the first part of something you have been avoiding.
cur.done: Done when one part of the avoided thing exists.

cur.title: Don’t Wait for Tomorrow
cur.summary: The comeback starts tonight, not Monday.
cur.cardSummary: Start something today that you were going to leave until tomorrow.
cur.done: Done when the 10-minute timer ends. Stopping then is allowed.

cur.title: Boredom
cur.summary: Boredom is withdrawal’s echo. It fades if you don’t feed it.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 10 minutes without filling boredom with new content.
cur.done: Done when the timer ends and nothing new was opened.

cur.title: Escaping Boredom
cur.summary: The reflex reach is the enemy. Put friction on the exits.
cur.cardSummary: Take a 20-minute walk without using your phone.
cur.done: Done after 20 phone-free minutes of walking.

cur.title: Learn to Be Bored
cur.summary: Sit in the flat minutes. They’re retraining your baseline.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 20 minutes on one slow, screen-free activity.
cur.done: Done when the timer ends without a screen.

cur.title: Screen Boundaries
cur.summary: Screens after ten made the rules. Take the hours back.
cur.cardSummary: Choose one screen-free time or place and follow the rule today.
cur.done: Done when the phone’s place is chosen and the rule held once.

cur.title: Dopamine Detox
cur.summary: You don’t need a detox monk-week. You need fewer triggers.
cur.cardSummary: Spend one hour without feeds, porn, news, or short-form content.
cur.done: Done when the hour passes without the set-aside feeds.

cur.title: Wake Up With Purpose
cur.summary: A planned morning outruns a random night.
cur.cardSummary: Prepare tomorrow’s first hour before you go to bed.
cur.done: Done when alarm, first activity, and kit are all ready.

cur.title: Meaning
cur.summary: Meaning is the long cure. Boredom can’t survive a mission.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 30 minutes on a person, project, skill, or responsibility that matters to you.
cur.done: Done when the 30 minutes are up.

cur.title: Why Relationships Matter
cur.summary: Recovery is a team sport played quietly.
cur.cardSummary: Invite someone to do something with a specific day and time.
cur.done: Done when the invitation has been sent.

cur.title: Loneliness
cur.summary: Loneliness is a signal, not a sentence. Answer it in person.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 30 minutes around other people, or have a 20-minute call if you cannot leave home.
cur.done: Done after 30 minutes around people — or a 20-minute call.

cur.title: Solitude
cur.summary: Alone on purpose is solitude. Alone by default is exposure.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 30 minutes alone without using your phone to escape the quiet.
cur.done: Done when the 30 minutes end without the phone as escape.

cur.title: What Porn Replaces
cur.summary: It rehearses connection with none of the risk. That’s the theft.
cur.cardSummary: Spend time with another person today, or make plans to.
cur.done: Done when the invitation is sent or the 20 minutes happened.

cur.title: Friendship
cur.summary: Friendships grow on schedules. Plant one this week.
cur.cardSummary: Turn one casual connection into a second meeting, call, or group session.
cur.done: Done when the next meeting, call, or session is set or attended.

cur.title: Unhealthy Relationships
cur.summary: Some rooms reopen the wound. Choose your rooms.
cur.cardSummary: Change one relationship, chat, or account that regularly leaves you worse.
cur.done: Done when the change is made — or plans exist with someone good.

cur.title: Healthy Relationships
cur.summary: Real intimacy is slower, riskier, and worth the trade.
cur.cardSummary: Do something today for a relationship you care about.
cur.done: Done when the call, plan, help, or apology is finished.

cur.title: Trauma
cur.summary: The habit started as armor. Thank it, then retire it.
cur.cardSummary: Write about a past experience that still affects you and how you want to handle it next time.
cur.done: Done when all four parts are written and next-time is prepared.

cur.title: Your Environment
cur.summary: If the house is on fire, stop blaming the smoke.
cur.cardSummary: Change one person, account, place, or routine that regularly leaves you more upset or more likely to use porn.
cur.done: Done when the exposure has actually changed.

cur.title: Self-Criticism
cur.summary: The inner critic isn’t a coach. Fire the voice, keep the standard.
cur.cardSummary: Replace one harsh judgment about yourself with the facts and one repair you can start now.
cur.done: Done when facts and repair are written and the repair has begun.

cur.title: Self-Loathing
cur.summary: Self-loathing feeds the loop it hates. Starve it.
cur.cardSummary: Replace one insult about yourself with facts, then do one basic thing for yourself.
cur.done: Done when facts replace the insult and the basic thing is done.

cur.title: Self-Compassion
cur.summary: Talk to yourself like someone you’re responsible for.
cur.cardSummary: Look at one recent mistake without insults and start the next useful action.
cur.done: Done when the three lines exist and the action has started.

cur.title: Self-Trust
cur.summary: Trust rebuilds in kept promises, smallest first.
cur.cardSummary: Make one small promise you can keep before bed, then keep it.
cur.done: Done when the promised action is finished before bed.

cur.title: Self-Improvement
cur.summary: Improvement is proof. Log the gains somewhere you’ll see.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 20 minutes practising a skill instead of watching advice about it.
cur.done: Done after 20 minutes of practice. Watching doesn’t count.

cur.title: Know Yourself
cur.summary: Know what pulls you, what drains you, what you’re for.
cur.cardSummary: Identify when you are most likely to relapse, what has helped before, and one change to make today.
cur.done: Done when all three are answered and the change is made.

cur.title: Amor Fati
cur.summary: Love the hand you were dealt. It’s the only playable one.
cur.cardSummary: Write about something in the past you cannot change and act on what is still possible now.
cur.done: Done when both parts are written and the possible one has begun.

cur.title: Memento Mori
cur.summary: Five years left: what stays, what goes, what starts tonight?
cur.cardSummary: Put one hour on the calendar for something porn or empty screen time has been taking time from.
cur.done: Done when the hour is booked and the first 10 minutes are spent.

cur.title: Carpe Diem
cur.summary: Seize the day means this one. Before noon.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 20 minutes doing something you keep saying you want to do more often.
cur.done: Done after the 20 minutes — or once the date is booked.

cur.title: The Next 90 Days
cur.summary: Ninety days is enough to change the trend line of a life.
cur.cardSummary: Choose one 90-day goal, schedule the weekly work, and start for 20 minutes today.
cur.done: Done when goal and weekly times exist and today’s 20 minutes ran.

cur.title: Peace of Mind
cur.summary: Peace of mind is the quiet dividend of kept vows.
cur.cardSummary: Spend 30 minutes tonight without incoming content.
cur.done: Done when 30 minutes pass without swapping one feed for another.

cur.title: This Time Next Year
cur.summary: Picture next year’s you. Start acting like their friend.
cur.cardSummary: Schedule the next four times you will do one thing you want in your life a year from now.
cur.done: Done when four dates are set and the first is ready to happen.

cur.title: What Forever Means
cur.summary: Forever is just today, kept daily.
cur.cardSummary: Choose one rule from the course to keep for the next 90 days and start it today.
cur.done: Done when the rule ran once today and the review date is booked.

cur.title: Twelve Weeks Ago
cur.summary: Twelve weeks ago this felt impossible. Read your own letter.
cur.cardSummary: Compare Week 1 with today in six parts of your life and recovery.
cur.done: Done when each line says what you did then and do now — no “better.”

cur.title: What Changed in Your Brain
cur.summary: The pathways quieted. The wiring is yours again.
cur.cardSummary: Practise one recovery action that has become easier three times today.
cur.done: Done when the same action has run three full times.

cur.title: Winning the Battle
cur.summary: Keep the morning pledge, the log, the walk. Drop the scaffolding.
cur.cardSummary: Use the three things that helped you most during the course.
cur.done: Done when all three have been used today.

cur.title: Lessons From Addiction Recovery
cur.summary: Borrow from the recovered: meetings, sponsors, service, honesty.
cur.cardSummary: Save three people or services you could contact if you start struggling.
cur.done: Done when three contacts and the message live in one note.

cur.title: Saying Goodbye
cur.summary: Say goodbye like you mean it. Write it down.
cur.cardSummary: Remove anything that still belongs to the old habit, or use the time for something you want to keep.
cur.done: Done when one remnant is gone — or 20 minutes went to what stays.

cur.title: The Future
cur.summary: The future is unwritten and finally yours to write.
cur.cardSummary: Write and pin a short plan for what you will do if things start slipping again.
cur.done: Done when the note is pinned and reads in under a minute.
